description: This PHP source file defines the 'SubscriptionPlan' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce framework. It manages subscription plan CRUD operations, including listing, creating, editing, copying, enabling, disabling, and deleting subscription plans. The class interacts with models for data handling and loads views for UI rendering. It includes methods for handling form submission, permissions, and data retrieval, with integrated localization support.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription plans in the admin panel of OpenCart, handling CRUD operations, status toggling, and form rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the main subscription plan list view, setting page title and including common components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads the list of subscription plans via getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Handles retrieving and rendering the list of subscription plans, including sorting, pagination, and URLs for actions.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a subscription plan, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of subscription plan data, both creating new and updating existing plans.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription plans after permission and dependency checks.
